response.original_title: Saut à la couverte – version non cataloguée
response.overview: The first version of Saut à la couverte, filmed in 1895. Unlike the 1896/7 version, this film was not entered into the Lumière's catalogue. It was, however, presented to the public in Lyon on 12 June 1895.
